name: mini-calendar

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows a selected day in white, today's accent and a populated two-item agenda.

tagline: A week of day chips with arrows to page, and the chosen day's agenda below.
summary: A compact horizontal strip of seven stacked month-and-day buttons between previous and next arrows. Clicking a day marks it and lists that day's events in a panel underneath.
appearance: A short rounded bordered strip holding a left chevron, seven narrow day cells with a tiny grey month above a bold number, and a right chevron on black. The selected day is a white pill, today a grey one; a bordered card below lists times and event titles.
behaviour: The arrows shift the window a whole week at a time. Hovering a day tints it grey and clicking it fills it white, while the panel below swaps to that date's heading and its list of events.
demo_content: Late November days and an agenda with items like Design review, Lunch with Priya and Climbing session.
search_phrases: pick a day and see events
use_when: A page needs a narrow date selector with the selected day's schedule right beside it.
avoid_when: It only pages through whole weeks and has no month grid, so reaching a distant date takes repeated clicks.
customise: Set the number of days, the starting date and the selected date through props, and compose the arrows, day cells and any agenda yourself; styling comes in as classes.
weight_why: Seven plain buttons and two chevrons; date-fns only computes the day labels.

a11y.note: The chevron arrows are icon-only with no label, so screen readers announce them as unlabelled buttons.

issues: Every cell repeats the month, so the strip is cluttered when all seven days share one month.
In frame 6 paging moves past the selected day, leaving no selected chip visible in the strip.
polish_why: Tidy strip with clear selected and today states; repeated months and off-window selection add noise.
title: Mini Calendar
